InstallerSettings.Label: Assign the device after install
InstallerSettings.Tooltip: Runs TeamViewer.exe assignment after a successful install so the device lands in your company account. Needs the Assignment ID below.

InstallerSettings.Label: Assignment ID
InstallerSettings.Tooltip: From Management Console, Design and Deploy: the assignment ID of your Host module. Leave empty to skip assignment.

InstallerSettings.Label: Assignment options
InstallerSettings.Tooltip: Extra switches for TeamViewer.exe assignment, for example --grant-easy-access, --device-alias %COMPUTERNAME%, --reassign.

PostInstallScript.Script:
$tv = Join-Path $env:ProgramFiles 'TeamViewer\TeamViewer.exe'
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $tv)) { Write-Host 'TeamViewer.exe not found; assignment skipped'; exit 0 }
$assignment = Start-Process -FilePath $tv -ArgumentList 'assignment --id {setting:AssignmentId} {setting:AssignmentOptions}' -Wait -PassThru -NoNewWindow
Write-Host "Assignment exit $($assignment.ExitCode)"
